12 Description: A survey conducted in late 2023 found that the most popular categories of products and services purchased online in Spain were fashion and leisure. Of those who made an internet purchase in the 12 months before the study, almost eight out of ten said
they had purchased either clothing and apparel or leisure items. Travel products ranked third, followed by footwear and accessories, with 74 and 73 percent of respondents, respectively. Read more
Note(s): October 18 to November 7, 2023; 2,200 respondents; 18-65 years; among those who purchased online in the last 12 months
Source(s): CanalSondeo; El Observatorio Cetelem

payments.text:
Description: Roughly six out of 10 e-commerce vendors in Spain offer buy now, pay later on their website come 2024. This is according to a survey held in early 2024, asking e-commerce professionals on which payment methods they are offering. Noticeable for Spain
is the substantial share of respondents who indicated they offer credit cards in 2024. Cryptocurrency also features in this list. The source does not clarify, however, whether merchants would like to accept direct payments with Bitcoin or [...] Read more
Note(s): Spain; February 2024; 2,700 respondents; 18 years and older; third-party panelists worldwide; Commerce professionals that held a director or higher leadership role; Professionals from B2B, B2C, and B2B2C companies across North America, Latin America,
Asia Pacific, Japan, and Europe
Source(s): Salesforce Research

forecast_users.text:
Description: The average revenue per user in the e-commerce market in Spain was modeled to amount to 1,142 U.S. dollars in 2025. From 2017 to 2025, the average revenue per user rose by 393 U.S. dollars, though the increase followed an uneven trajectory rather
than a consistent upward trend. Between 2024 and 2030, the average revenue per user will rise by 203 U.S. dollars, showing an overall upward trend with periodic ups and downs.Further information about the methodology, more market [...] Read more
Note(s): Spain; 2017 to 2030; estimates
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights

Description: The COVID-19 outbreak led to a substantial surge in e-commerce transactions in Spain. From nearly 227 million in the first quarter of 2020, the number of online transactions exceeded 300 million by the end of the year. Even after businesses reopened as
the crisis subsided, the volume of e-commerce transactions remained above pre-pandemic levels. In the second quarter of 2024, the number of e-commerce transactions surpassed 422 million. Read more

Description: According to a 2024 study, computers are the primary devices for online shopping in Spain, and they are used by almost three-quarters (73 percent) of online shoppers surveyed. Mobile phones are also highly popular for this activity, coming close with 66
percent of respondents. Read more
Note(s): Spain; May 2024; 1,000 online buyers; 16-74 years
Source(s): Elogia; IAB Spain
